title: Munsi y'igicucu cya Palme y'itariki
intro: Inkuru irasohora ivuga ku bugingo bwashyizwe ku ruhande mbere yo kuvuka, burerewe mu nkuta zera, kandi bugahitamo kwerekana ikimenyetso isi itari yarigeze ibona. Ubwo ibirego byaturukaga impande zose, ijwi ryaturutse ahantu hadasanzwe ho gucecekesha gushidikanya kose. Ese ushobora kumenya uwanyuze munsi y'igicucu cy'umukindo?
clues: Nari niyeguriye umurimo w'Imana Ishoborabyose mbere yuko ntangira guhumeka, isezerano ryatanzwe n'uwantwaye.
Nakuriye munsi y’ubwitonzi bw’umurinzi w’umukiranutsi mu byumba byera by’ahantu ho gusengera.
Igihe cyose umurinzi wanjye yazaga mu cyumba cyanjye, yasangaga mfite ibyo kurya byo mu bihe bitagombaga kubaho.
Nahawe inkuru nziza y'umuhungu, nubwo imimerere yanjye itatanze umwanya wo kubahiriza ibyo nari narasezeranijwe.
Nagiye ahantu kure, maze ngezeyo umukindo wampaye igicucu mu gihe umugezi watembaga munsi yawo.
Ubwo ibirego byazaga n'ibibazo bimwubikiye, neretse umwana wanjye wari uherutse kuvuka — maze avuga kuva mu bwana bwe kugira ngo acecekeshe gushidikanya kose.
